Repowise: Local Code and Context Intelligence Engine for AI Agents

The video features Repowise, an open source tool that indexes the repository to the local machine and delivers this context to AI agents by MCP. Shows the five layers of the index, the pull requests review robot, code health analysis and the workspace with various repositories.

Published in 20 September 2026 · 7 min 36 s

  • Agentic engineering
  • AI tools

Open on YouTube

The video and the transcript are in Portuguese. The minutes between brackets lead to the stretch of the video.

The problem of context

AI assistants write fast code, but often do not know the impact of change on the entire system 00:00. Repowise is a code intelligence engine designed to give this context to people and agents 00:20.

Without a map, the agent rediscovers the code base for each task. Spends time and tokens with simple searches in a sea of files and reads the same things several times 00:20. According to the video, Repowise reduces the size of the context sent to AI by 97.2% 00:42.

Video compares both ways of working 01:47:

  • In the old way, the agent uses searches like grep, reads hundreds of noise lines and makes almost eight tool calls, on average, to locate himself 01:47.
  • With Repowise, the agent uses 10 MCP tools, makes about 3.8 calls and receives the context already directed 02:07.

The five layers of the index

Repowise indexes the code base once on the local machine without sending data to external services 02:07. The index has five layers 02:29:

  • the graph, which understands the dependencies 02:29;
  • Git, which maps bug history 02:29;
  • documentation, generated as an automatic wiki 02:29;
  • the decisions, which keep the logic of architecture 02:50;
  • code health, measured by deterministic detectors 02:50.

According to the video, full indexing of a normal repository takes less than 30 seconds 02:50.

Background for agents

The bridge between the index and the agents is MCP, the Model Context Protocol: an open standard that links the models to local data safely 03:11. By MCP, Repowise delivers the index to agents such as Claude Code, Cursor and VS Code integrations 03:11.

In the numbers cited, the context drops from about 14,000 tokens to 393 tokens in a commit test 03:32. The total output volume of the agent drops almost 32% 03:55. The 10 MCP tools are made for specific tasks and deliver the full context at once, with the code quotes 03:55.

Smarter Pull requests

Human reviewers use the same index, for a free robot of pull requests 04:16. The robot shows the impact radius of changing a symbol, warns when a file is missing that usually changes together and brings test information connected to the graph 04:36. He gives a risk note from 0 to 10, without calling any LLM, and stays silent when the PR has no problem 04:36.

Code health

The tool also measures and improves code base maintenance in three steps 04:57:

1. Scan with deterministic detectors (video speaks 49) 05:18. 2. Identifies the most trouble-prone files and gives them a score from 1 to 10 05:18. 3. Generates concrete refactoring plans, how to extract a class 05:18.

Compared to traditional tools such as CodeScene, with the same 20% revision budget of the code, Repowise found 2.3 times more real defects 05:39.

Several repositories

Large systems are not in one repository 06:01. Repowise links contracts between backend and frontend services: if a change in one repository breaks another's contract, it shows the impact before sending the code 06:23. Everything stays in one endpoint Federated MCP 06:23.

The central phrase

The video cites the creators of the tool: AI makes it cheaper to produce a change, but does not make it cheaper to understand the consequences of it 06:23. The final question is whether, in the next task, the agent will continue without a map or will have a 07:06.

Frequently Asked Questions

Repowise sends the code out of the machine?

Nope. According to the video, indexing is done locally, without sending data to external services 02:07.

What agents does Repowise work with?

With agents that use MCP, such as Claude Code, Cursor and VS Code integrations 03:11.

Does the pull request robot use LLM?

Nope. The video says he gives the risk note without calling any LLM 04:36.

About the video

In this explanatory video, we present **Repowise**, an open-source tool that builds a local index of its source code to provide accurate and citable context for AI developers and agents.

Instead of having AI assistants re-elect files repeatedly, Repowise indexes the repository and provides direct responses, dependencies charts, and change risk analysis via **MCP (Model Context Protocol)**.

---

♪ What are you gonna learn in this video ♪
* **5 Local Intelligence Layers:** Dependency Graph (AST in 26 languages), Git history, automatically generated wiki documentation, architectural decisions and code health deterministic punctuation (Code Health).
* **Integration with AI agents:** How to connect Repowise to Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and VS Code using integrated MCP tools.
* ==References== Reduction of payloads and compression of terminal outputs with 'repowise distill'.
==References====External links== How to evaluate the impact area and the affected tests before performing the merge.
